home_meta_title: Lumen Grove: Cozy Forest Farm — Android, iOS Planned | Points.GS
home_meta_description: Lumen Grove, a cozy forest farming game by Points Game Studio. Android available now; iOS planned. Grow plants, earn Light, and help the Magic Oak grow.
home_hero_kicker: Points Game Studio · Built for Wonder
home_hero_tagline: Grow a magical grove, help its woodland residents, and turn small acts of kindness into Light for the Magic Oak. Make this little forest your own.
home_play_btn: Get Lumen Grove on Google Play
home_about_p1: Lumen Grove is a cozy mobile game about restoring a magical forest. Plant and harvest, help woodland residents, decorate your own little grove, and uncover its forgotten stories. Caring for the forest earns Light, which helps the Magic Oak grow.
home_glance_1: Grow your own grove with plants to nurture and harvest
home_glance_2: Small acts of kindness bring Light to the Magic Oak
home_glance_3: Make it your own with woodland and seasonal decorations
home_glance_4: A living forest with changing weather and hidden stories
home_features_title: A little forest to call your own
home_feat_1_text: Plant, nurture, and harvest. Watch your little patch of forest become a thriving grove.
home_feat_2_text: Get to know the woodland residents and uncover the memories hidden among the trees and ruins.
home_feat_3_text: Choose mushroom, gothic, Celtic, and seasonal decorations to give the grove your own touch.
home_feat_4_text: Rain, mist, gentle snow, and auroras bring a different mood to the forest.
home_feat_5_text: Plant, harvest, clear new areas, and help residents to earn Light. Give it to the Magic Oak and help it grow stronger.
home_feat_6_text: Seasonal events bring a fresh atmosphere, special tasks, decorations, and new stories to explore.
home_halloween_kicker: Seasonal event · Now in the grove
home_halloween_title: 🎃 Halloween Has Arrived in Lumen Grove
home_halloween_text: The grove has changed. Discover a spooky new atmosphere, seasonal decorations, special tasks, seasonal mini-games, and the story of the Raven King.
home_faq_a1: A cozy forest farming and restoration game for Android. Grow plants, decorate your grove, help its residents, and discover the stories of a magical world. An iOS version is planned.
home_faq_q2: How do I help the forest grow?
home_faq_a2: Plant and harvest, clear new areas, and help the forest residents. These everyday actions earn Light. Give that Light to the Magic Oak to help it grow and level up, while you keep restoring and decorating the grove.
home_faq_a3: Lumen Grove is available on Android through Google Play. An iOS version is planned.

news5_paragraph_1: Why do games need weather at all? Especially if it does not add anything to the gameplay and does not affect the game rules in any way. At first glance, it seems like exactly the kind of feature that should be cut from the scope first, especially during early development.
home_devlog6_text: The first seasonal event is here — mini-games, quests, new decorations, a new lore chapter, and a reworked Magic Oak progression.
